assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is being evaluated
The service is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The payer denied the claim under CO-197 for a missing precertification
The service was rendered to document and evaluate the patient's symptomatic cardiac events
